identity.title: A VIPR that wraps: A triplex biochemistry for next-gen biotechnology.

content.abstract: A putative ancestor to CRISPR systems, VIPR, was recently discovered.(1)(,)(2) VIPR adopts a distinct non-contiguous code for PAM-free RNA-guided DNA recognition and is ultracompact and reprogrammable, making it a promising candidate for various genome-manipulation applications. Many open questions remain and their answers will foster exciting opportunities for next-generation biotechnology.
